coverageNotes: Employee schedules accepted from the 12 November 2026 collection-priorities register. Each original matches the register SHA-256; every row was read by two independent methods and the named rows reconcile exactly to the printed controls.

sources.title: UNBC Statement of Financial Information 2021/22: employee remuneration (Board package, 16 September 2022)
sources.scopeDescription: Named employees with remuneration over $75,000; board schedule and aggregate rows excluded
notes: The complete named employee schedule on physical PDF pages 11-17 (printed package pages 16-22 of 120) of the 16 September 2022 Board public-session package is imported with positions and original cents. The Board of Governors schedule (PDF page 10; board members receive no remuneration) and the below-threshold and grand totals are not employee rows.

Named remuneration sums exactly to the printed $40,670,870.80 and expenses to the printed $619,232.02. All 80 printed 0.00 expense cells are kept as explicit zeros; the schedule prints no dash or blank expense cells.
Approval: the approved minutes of the 16 September 2022 Board public session record motion 2022BP09.16.03 approving the Financial Information Act report to March 31, 2022 as presented (item 7(i)(a)).

The source states that total remuneration excludes employer payments for non-taxable benefits, CPP, EI and WCB and payments under severance agreements, and that accrual accounting causes differences from the financial statements.

validation.independentMethod: pdftotext -layout rows compared field-for-field (page, name, position, literal remuneration and expense cells) with pdfplumber glyph-geometry columns; exact agreement required
validation.expenseCellConvention: Printed dash and blank expense cells are null in the normalized rows; the evidence file keeps which was printed. Printed 0.00 stays 0.
validation.reportingPeriodBasis: Every schedule page is headed "FOR THE YEAR ENDED MARCH 31, 2022"; the approved Board motion covers the Financial Information Act report to March 31, 2022.

approvalEvidence.supports: The approved minutes record that the Board approved the Financial Information Act report to March 31, 2022 as presented; the motion carried.

validation.visualReview: Rendered PDF page 17 and compared the final rows and all three printed control lines; no row values were changed.
